models.name: PGSuper-WSDOT
models.comment: The WF66G and WF100G girders are in the WSDOT library: they match their library entries and fill their strand grids. Without it (the run's configuration) the import makes new entries

models.name: PGSuper-LongitudinalRebar
models.comment: The PGSuper model with five rows of longitudinal girder bars (top and bottom faces; full length, from the left and right ends, and centered layouts; #4, #5, and #6 bars) instead of the library's single top row

models.name: PGSuper-Superelevation-Skew
models.comment: The superelevation model with skewed piers (20 L, 10 L, normal, 15 R): the deck is cut along skewed lines across the superelevation transition

models.name: TxDOT
models.comment: The US 77 CRP test model (OpenBridge Designer, BridgeOnly-spatialized): an IfcBridge with PredefinedType NOTDEFINED, abutments and piers without referents or bearings of their own (they are located at the support lines of the girder ends and bearings), and two structures side by side, each deck in slabs between joints (the one on the alignment is imported)
expect_log: elements are selected as the deck
